title: F3 Carbon Matte Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Built for aggressive dirt performance, the Klim F3 Carbon Matte Black is crafted for intense dirt riding with ultra-wide goggle eyeport stabilization across punishing tracks and trails. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell tips the scales at a featherweight 1337g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~99 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ECE 22.05 impact standards. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Lightweight carbon MX helmet with Klim channeled EPS ventilation.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Aggressive fit designed for motocross and enduro; requires cheek pads for full-face coverage.

technical_analysis: Features Hand-laid Karbonite Carbon Fiber shell construction optimized for extreme adventure dual-sport touring paired with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor. The interior utilizes Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Klim F3 Carbon Matte Black: combining United States 🇺🇸 craftsmanship with Fidlock magnetic quick-release chinstrap buckle with distortion-free optical shield and peak visor and Klimatek cooling fabric interior with high-volume chin intake ventilation. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Klim F3 Carbon Matte Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Klim F3 Carbon Matte Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Klim's Dirt / MX lineup, the F3 Carbon Matte Black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Klim F3 Carbon Matte Black represents Klim's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~99 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Klim F3 Carbon Matte Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
